purpose: Mark a provisional action or a minimum standard met.
keywords: I have read through all the materials for an initial check.
It does not look like rain, but I will take an umbrella just in case.
I made a provisional booking, but we can change the number later.
restrictions: Often leaves room for revision or further work.
mistake: It may qualify confidence; it does not always mean completion.
